en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad market square with historic buildings. On the left stands an ornate town hall-like building with a clock tower and bay window; on the right, at the far end of the square, is a church with a tall tower and clock. Lined townhouses and shops with awnings run along the square. Sparse pedestrians are visible. Printed red text reads "Adorf i. V." at the top left and "Markt." at the top center. A red number is written in the upper right corner. At the bottom left appears the printer credit "Bruck & Sohn, Meissen" and the number "8928".
